stories.headline: Takaichi holds first Washington summit with Trump, navigates Iran and Strait of Hormuz pressure
stories.summary: Prime Minister Takaichi visited Washington March 18-21 for her first White House summit with President Trump. The meeting focused heavily on Iran conflict and US pressure for Japanese military assistance in Strait of Hormuz security. Despite Trump's Pearl Harbor joke and demands for warship deployment, Takaichi avoided major confrontation while citing constitutional constraints.
